text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho and first G1 race of the senior year has arrived and will serve as the stage for Ryan's fierce battle with McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen is aiming to fulfill her long-held dream, while Mejiro Ryan is looking to stop her and prove her own true worth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither competitor is willing to concede their goals in the race that begins.
